answer: New identities must collect attestations from three independent issuers, each staking 200 POA and capped at 100 identities per epoch; a duplicate attestation slashes the issuer and freezes the fake. Each issuer level is a terrace an attacker must climb, and no single corrupt issuer can mint identities alone. Each extra fake needs three fresh attestations, so 100 fakes consume 300 slots and push issuers toward their caps, raising bribes like a river in flood, while honest users take only three. Stakes, caps and attestations sit on-chain for a glacier audit before payouts unlock.
